checks.name: strict request schemas, body bounds, invalid identifiers, and safe provider absence
staging has no connector effects, and reject is durable and idempotent
provider-independent HTTP gateway uses trusted grants, exact receipts, and mandatory review
standard execution persists one invoice/refund and one queued reply under repeated and concurrent requests
strict and high-value plans require explicit receipt-bound approval
two proposals from one invoice version cannot both commit; failed transactions leave no partial outbox
blocked attack effects are excluded while permitted support actions still execute

scope: Local authenticated replay agent with actual durable D1 writes and a cancellable sandbox outbox. No model calls or mail delivery.
